Used PIL to zoom-crop the header/ring-band region at both the shot's very first frame (186.40s, header already drawn) and a late frame (189.10s) for pixel-level inspection. Result: the red header 'Halaman rencana Vidka' now sits clearly below the notebook's 8 spiral rings with a visible vertical gap at every sampled frame -- no ring loop touches or crosses any letterform, at any point in the shot's duration. The four body lines (Masalah/Pertanyaan/Data/Alasan, now at y=205/247/289/331) and both underlines (y=231 under Masalah, y=367 under Alasan) were confirmed via the same frames to stagger in correctly, land under only their own line with no cross-text collision, and stay well clear of the notebook's bottom edge (~y=535), leaving a large empty margin below 'Alasan'. (4) Re-confirmed shot-41's other six B1 checks (drawing_character, semantic_acting, contact_continuity, timing_pacing, sound) directly against the same 11 frames plus project.json's shot-41 layer data; all still hold as v3 described, with contact_continuity's note about the body text/underlines clearing the ring band now also covering the header, which was the only previously-failing element. (5) Spot-checked shot-42 (189.5, 190.7, 191.5, 192.3s): confirmed its evidence.json plan bounds (189.375-192.375s) and all visual content (task card text, underline, checkmark, pose-swap, music-credit line) are pixel-identical in composition to v3's description -- this shot was not touched by the header-position fix. (6) Re-confirmed the two pre-existing non-blocking findings from v3 via fresh frame extraction and zoomed crops: shot-17 at 75.157s still shows the top of 'Bagaimana kelompok kami' touching the spiral-ring band at the shot-17/18 cut (sub-second flash, unchanged); shot-22 at 90.4s still shows the notebook's top-right ring loop overlapping Ardipal's chin/beard (unchanged). Neither was modified or worsened by this revision's fix, and neither was altered, per the task's instruction to leave these known, previously-accepted limitations alone. (7) All other 40 shots (0-40, 42, plus the untouched checks of 17/22) are carried forward verbatim from findings-film-v3.json without re-verification beyond the shot-42/17/22 spot checks above, since this round's only change was shot-41's header y-position and the task scoped re-verification to shot-41 (full), shot-42 (spot-check) and shots 17/22 (spot-check).
